title: LaborRequest v0.1
description: The atomic object of the SocioProphet Labor Network: a structured request, NOT a generic post (charter v0.1 §3, LN-001/003/004). Introduces demand into the network. Compensation disclosure is mandatory unless the request is explicitly comp_exempt (typed volunteer/mutual_aid/exploratory, LN-004) — cross-field teeth live in tools/labor-request-contract/labor_contract.py.

request_type.description: The LN-002 request taxonomy. Job posts are too narrow; the network needs a typed request protocol.

compensation_disclosed.description: LN-004: compensation transparency is mandatory for labor requests, except comp_exempt requests.

comp_exempt.description: True only for requests explicitly typed volunteer/mutual_aid/exploratory (LN-004). A comp_exempt request may omit disclosed compensation.

deadline.description: Response deadline; closure status visible to counterparties (LN-018).

evaluation_criteria.description: Request-specific rubric (charter §7.3). Every criterion must be job-/request-related; there is NO universal candidate score (LN-009).
